claims.assertion: Mari says Suzy-class time navigation uses frequency maps rather than calendar dates, making conversion to modern chronology unreliable.
claims.speaker: Mari Swaruu

claims.assertion: Mari suspects the Federation directed the erasure of Tartaria and other Earth histories, but says Federation archives conflict and she cannot establish a definitive account.
claims.speaker: Mari Swaruu
claims.qualifiers: Mari frames this as her interpretation and says the evidence is inconclusive.
